name: Quit
overview: Scripture exhorts believers to persevere and not to quit in the face of adversity, emphasizing that fainting or giving up reveals a weakness of strength (Proverbs 24:10). Instead, those who wait on the Lord will find renewed strength to endure without weariness or fainting (Isaiah 40:31), and are encouraged to persist in prayer and good works, assured that perseverance will lead to a harvest in due time (Luke 18:1; Galatians 6:9). Jesus Himself taught the necessity of steadfast commitment, warning that looking back after beginning the journey of faith disqualifies one from the kingdom of God (Luke 9:62), while Paul models this by pressing forward, forgetting past failures and focusing on the future goal (Philippians 3:13).
